candidates.original_title: A randomized field trial of the Pathway Project cognitive strategies approach to text-based analytical writing for mainstreamed English learners in secondary school
candidates.description: The Pathway Project cognitive strategies professional development program improves academic writing outcomes for secondary school Latinos and English learners
candidates.citation_sentence: This prior study yielded effect sizes of .35 in Year 1 and .67 in Year 2 on an on-demand assessment of academic writing. It also showed that the Pathway Project had a small but statistically significant impact on the writing subtest of the California Standards Test (CST; Kim et al., 2011; Olson et al., 2012).
candidates.notes: [ling26: no entry matched this anchor] Year 2 of the AUHSD replication; original SAUSD study identified as Kim et al. (2011) and Olson et al. (2012); no DOI available for the original study in the paper.
